newsitem.title: USA: Polyphase target of two lawsuits.
newsitem.headline: Polyphase target of two lawsuits.

text.p: Polyphase Corp said Friday that two complaints have been filed in the U.S. District Court for the District of Nevada against the company and some of its officers and directors.

The lawsuits, which it described in a news release as "substantially identical," seek class-action status and assert liability based on alleged misrepresentations that resulted in the market price of its stock being artificially inflated.
The company said it intends to vigorously defend itself.
Polyphase is a diversified holding company with nationwide operations in the frozen food, forestry equipment and electronics industries.
